title: Act 1 fight: the githyanki patrol at the Mountain Pass (Tactician)
task: Win the fight: defeat the githyanki patrol.
scored_by: Passed the first moment the fight ahead of you is won (a combat that ends with the enemies beaten and the party standing; a fight with other enemies doesn't count). Nothing else counts toward the score: party members downed or killed, game time and cost are reported next to it.
about: The Tactician variant of fight_act1_gith_patrol: the same fight from the same moment, the same goal and caps, with the game's difficulty at Tactician instead of Balanced (tougher enemies, a smarter enemy AI). Fight (family 1), small and elite: a githyanki patrol of a few strong warriors and casters. claude-run-2 S023 nearly wiped and reloaded once; it won only after a full rest and Hold Person. Start save: no long rest (camp supplies 35 of 40 are too few), full HP, one level-2 spell slot spent; Wyll is at camp.
